what: PRED-0013 single-pass evaluation of apo 5UAK non-covalent tertiary packing compliance s_flex(i) = 1 / (1 + (361/25)*WCN_nc(i)) against US FDA TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 on the fixed 20-variant held-out test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal)
why: Refuted against pre-registered >= 0.75 thresholds despite beating both baselines: s_flex achieved conditional missense ROC-AUC 0.700000 (7/10 = 21/30 pairs, vs s_AM 0.533333) and gated g_flex achieved abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.742424 (49/66 pairs, vs sequence-consequence 0.681818 and g_AM 0.691919).
